author: Lintuxer
description:
MediaCMS turns your ZimaOS box into your own video portal: upload, it
transcodes to several resolutions, and plays back in the browser with
playlists, categories, comments and user accounts. No cloud, no telemetry.

**Log in at `/admin`** — the first account is `admin`. Its password is the
`ADMIN_PASSWORD` variable and it is only read on the very first start.

Uploads live in `/DATA/AppData/mediacms/media_files`. Transcoding is real
CPU work — a long video keeps the `celery_worker` container busy for a while.

**amd64 only.** Upstream publishes no arm64 image, so this will not run on
a ZimaBoard.

tips.before_install:
**Change four values before installing** — open "Advanced (show more)". Every copy of this file ships with the same ones.

- `ADMIN_PASSWORD` (service `migrations`) — creates the admin account on first start and is read only then.

- `SECRET_KEY` — must be the SAME string on all four mediacms services. Django signs sessions with it.

- `POSTGRES_PASSWORD` — must match on `db` and on all four mediacms services.

- `FRONTEND_HOST` — `http://<your-zimaos-ip>:8010`. Only the links inside notification e-mails and RSS items are built from it; the web interface follows whatever address you typed, and you can log in without touching it.

**amd64 only** — upstream ships no arm64 image.

title: MediaCMS
